The csv-import feature is delivered end to end — parse, mapping, dry-run commit — and the duplicate rule was settled as date+payee+amount. Mutation testing found that no test asserts the reason a rejected line carries, and `test_importer.py:16` confirms it, keeping only the line number and throwing the reason away. saved-views is stalled on two questions, one claimed, one untouched — its spec's Solution is still two behavioural sentences with no surface at all.

## next

- saved-views/05 — nothing in the feature is drawn until you rule on the list's shape; 02's floor depends on it.
- The flaky upload test — the fix has landed in the tree already; only D1 is open, and no test opens a file now.
- retire-the-legacy-exporter — `export_csv` appears nowhere but its own ticket; verification looks nearly done.

These three can run at the same time. Hold csv-import/06 until the flake ruling — both edit the same test.
